title: Page: from 20 s, about 10% of requests fail and p99 goes up to about 750 ms.
explain: Nothing is broken: at 20 s the users' traffic becomes 4×. The API and the database cannot take it: queues grow and timeouts go up. Open "Users" and the requests sent each second show it.
hint: Add capacity: 12 API Server instances, 32 database connections.
